name: 13store-public-security-twin
description: 13STORE Digital Twin for Public Security — command centre, API server, edge gateway and field app

scripts.build: npm run build -w @13store/web && npm run build -w @13store/field && npm run build -w @13store/server && npm run build -w @13store/gateway
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build:single -w @13store/web && rm -rf vercel-out && mkdir -p vercel-out && cp apps/web/dist-single/index.html vercel-out/index.html
